note: Derived path invariant. Encode E:(i,j)->(i+1,j), S:(i,j)->(i,j-1). Initial empty set is E^(m-1)S^(n-1). A legal move changes an empty ES corner to SE. Converse uses reverse SE->ES swaps and inversion-count termination. Different words have different empty-cell sets by first divergence. Count is C(m+n-2,m-1); boundary m=1 or n=1 gives one configuration.
